name: imprint
description: This repository is its own marketplace and carries exactly one plugin: imprint, a set of working rules for multi-agent collaboration and for knowledge that has to stay provable.

plugins.name: imprint
plugins.description: Working rules in two layers: multi-agent collaboration (delegation contract, measuring before asserting, session handover) and knowledge keeping for a store that stays provable, plus a read-only review agent, a core card injected at session and subagent start, a hook that logs how long each subagent ran, and a hook that watches for updates of the host (Claude Code or Codex) and offers a review after an upgrade.
